name: Kinetic Engineering Limited
about: Kinetic Engineering Limited manufactures and supplies automotive components in India and internationally. The company provides transmission components, such as gears, shafts, gearboxes, sleeves, broached parts, and knuckle assembly; driveline components, which include spline yoke and stub shaft; and electric vehicle components, including chassis and body parts, 2-wheeler GB assembly, and rigid and trans axle. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Pune, India.
